how: Members recruit other Purples and repeat calls to place only purple.
Members judge rival numbers and temporary streamer support insufficient for sustained occupation.
A minimal question asks what is happening without establishing the substance of any resulting explanation.
Criticism of outward orders shows conflict over work without establishing withdrawal, apology or repair of a personal quarrel.
A member proposes an only-purple effort and asks others to join without requiring observed joining to establish the starter role.
Members propose flags, lettering and figures rather than one uncontested shared image.
Members report progress and repeated placing followed by white overwrites.
Anchor coordinates locate a figure and a border without establishing a universally followed template.
The room occupies the decided-order minority through an Emperor, accepted office and a Vice Emperor appointment.
A recipient accepts an organising office in one affirmative line and promises to perform its duties.
Bare acceptance ratifies an organising office as well as placement participation.
Strategy moves into Discord and agreement reports return to Reddit while venue acceptability is contested.
Chat participation is divided by role so venue migration includes differentiated access.
A call proposes entering a rival Discord without demonstrating successful infiltration.
Sleep, travel and reported inability to use a phone constrain participation.
An unlimited-dots report records apparent unusual site behaviour without proving extra pixels reached the shared canvas.
An unexplained extra-dots report and suspected hostile bots do not establish own scripts, spare accounts or automated placements.
Members replace overwritten pixels, call reinforcements and urge home defence over further offences.
Upkeep remains disputed when members allocate scarce pixels between home, allies and streamer attacks.
Explaining resistance to a design change requires distinguishing deliberate doctrinal rejection from keepers failing to receive an update.
Members attribute attacks to a streamer and blame leadership decisions for loss without independently verifying those explanations.
Members accept alliances, propose non-aggression and report failed compromise.
A self-described ambassador carries an alliance proposal against a shared opponent.
Expected reciprocity justifies helping other colours and calling for their defence.
Membership and an agreement are announced but later reports of failed talks limit claims of durable cooperation.
A coalition offer may be refused when its planning venue is unacceptable to the prospective participant.
Members provisionally spare a tree and appeal to attackers to protect neighbouring art.
Restraint depends on distinctions between protected art, peaceful colours and an explicitly targeted blue enemy.
A prospective guest offers defence for land and the host later accuses visitors of building despite refusal.
Claiming approval authority does not establish an ability to enforce refusal against guest placers.
The host frames building despite refusal as a breach of fair dealing.
A reported Discord agreement prompts the leader to ask who actually agreed.
An early proposal chooses the top-left corner before a larger area without establishing every subsequent pre-loss adjustment.
The leader reports relocation and directs members to Discord while the replacement site remains unspecified.
Helping other colours and invoking earlier comradeship do not establish membership on both sides of a current contest.
Members profess colour loyalty and invoke prior Button identity while companionship supports an office appointment.
An only-purple body develops role-based chat and later reports a factional split and relocation without establishing the exact creation of its subreddit.
Members make colour-war jokes and mock exceptions to the only-purple motto without establishing unanimous uptake.
A request to remove a purple swastika refuses a hate symbol without demonstrating completed removal.
Button memory does not establish a pre-canvas quarrel with the later blue opponent.
Colour doctrine names blue as an enemy but the concepts cannot establish that the rivalry predated the canvas.
Imperial rhetoric and colour humour do not establish a separate host prank or takeover.
A proposed merger of existing venues does not show host containment of canvas posts or creation of a canvas sub.
Criticism of outward orders does not show attacks on the room mark motivated by objections to canvas posts.
Members toast fighters, thank participation and award honours after the shared effort.
Celebration can honour effort amid reported territorial loss and relocation without requiring an uncontested completed mark.
A participant records the reported fate of the corner by saying the Void is taking it again.
A post-event reply offers another place-like experience without establishing migration or a continuing collective.
Thanks and medals do not establish corrections to historical claims or contest over a cleaned canvas copy.
A proposed subreddit sign supplies no evidence that viewers actually arrived through it.
Relaying a streamer attack does not show the work being presented for an outside creator or institution to acknowledge.
Members propose attacks, relay a streamer raid and prescribe pixel-saving sign defacement.
Members taunt their blue opponent and rally through claims of earlier victory.
Calls and subsequent placing reports do not identify building caused by answering a particular call.
Proposals and recruitment occur without a cited relation establishing a particular starter as the source of a later call.
Placing and repairing overlap without establishing a completed part as the cause of upkeep.
Defence and failed compromise do not establish that erosion caused the turn to negotiation.
Provisional permission and an alleged ignored refusal require separating announced restraint from effective agreement enforcement.
Reporting suspected hostile bots cannot establish that upkeep strain caused own automation uptake.
Thanks and honours mark effort without establishing that a completed-building report caused celebration.
Celebration supplies no resulting request to preserve images or document changes.
A successor-experience offer lacks a link establishing that recording the work produced continuation.
Manpower concerns and a later relocation report do not identify the decision or establish scarcity as its cause.
Design proposals and coordinates do not show a posted template settling an earlier design argument.
Bare acceptance is locally visible for an organising office while silence cannot establish placement acceptance.
Support offers and cooperation calls do not establish that a shortage of hands caused help to arrive.
Defence offered for space remains a proposal when the host says refusal was ignored, so negotiation cannot establish completed reciprocal exchange.
Recruitment can directly answer an attack proposal, preventing an exclusively mobilisation-first local explanation.
Cost-based restraint answers reinforcement allocation inside an attack thread rather than immediately answering its opening call.
Anti-attack norms and proposed peace do not establish a specific attack call causing a neighbour deal.
Taunts and victory rhetoric do not identify a specific preceding attack as the cause of the verbal contest.
Shared danger generates proposed joint defence while durable coalition operation remains unverified.
Recruitment and a merger proposal do not establish flood-driven moderation or creation of a canvas sub.
Checking who participated in an agreement does not establish the bounded mechanism of members refusing compliance or denying that placers can be bound.
Claimed command and accepted office coexist with disputed allocations, requiring a distinction between declared leadership and verified obedience.

statement: reporting suspected hostile automation to moderators
how: Members seek intervention against suspected bots rather than demonstrably multiplying their own placements.

statement: breaking an alliance over how faithfully a design embodies the colour
how: A design supported for survival becomes grounds for terminating an alliance over adherence to colour doctrine.

statement: recruiting in response to an attack proposal
how: A corner-attack proposal directly elicits a demand for more people and recruitment.
Coalition membership depends on disputed colour doctrine when support for lattice explicitly terminates an alliance.
